shortBulletSummary: Crypto markets rallied with Bitcoin surpassing $87K and a 5.34% increase in total market cap, alongside altcoin surges.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index reached 78, indicating extreme greed and high FOMO, a level not seen since July 2025.
A short squeeze led to over $648 million in crypto shorts being liquidated in 24 hours, supported by institutional buying.
Falling oil prices and eased Treasury yields provided macro relief, boosting risk assets including crypto.
Binance is under investigation by the DOJ for alleged violations of Iran sanctions.
